_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed. LIGHT ticks skip only scan+research: if resolve.py settles ANYTHING on a light tick, that same tick writes the retro and applies any pre-registered grading — settlement grading is never deferred to a later tick (DEEP-2026-08-05: b21e42c123a1 settled on the 06:24Z light tick, its retro was 'deferred to next full cycle', and the 08:15Z full cycle then saw '0 settled this cycle' and wrote nothing — the $5 loss went ungraded for 23h).
reason: 2026-08-07 23:15Z full cycle: session started HEAD-detached at 09c0cd9 with local main ref stale at f44fcab (recurring shallow-clone artifact, same pattern documented in every recent cycle) -- a full unshallow fetch confirmed origin/main truly at 09c0cd9 (matching HEAD exactly, no divergence, prior push had landed), reattached via `git checkout -B main origin/main`, no data loss. Collision guard: tip commit (22:20:47Z) was 55min old, >20min threshold, proceeded. next_full_cycle_after (22:46Z) had passed, ran full cycle. Operator-notes: 2026-08-05 ~20:30Z section (most recent, unchanged) re-verified already integrated (fit rubric + funnel instrumentation + exploration budget present in playbook.md), no new work. Settle: 0/19 (1 still open, unchanged). Score: brier_delta +0.1237, z=-2.73, unchanged (n=19, no new settlements). Scan: 4 queries -> 1025 candidates, no fallback (liquid-multiday 71, by-liquidity 475, active-today 447, econ-tag 32). Research: tonight's later MLB slate (Astros/Padres, Rays/Mariners, first pitch 01:40-01:45Z), both games' standard run lines devigged against 2+ corroborating books -- Astros/Padres HOU-1.5 fair 0.347 vs PM ask 0.37 (Yes side) / No side edge 0.013; Rays/Mariners TB-1.5 fair 0.331-0.336 vs PM ask 0.35, No side edge ~0.00-0.01; both well under min_edge_book_devig 0.07, market-agrees. Rays -2.5 alt line (single-book BetRivers only) fair 0.196, PM No-side edge 0.034, still short of floor and lower-confidence (uncorroborated single book). Padres -1.5 reverse alt line: no matching single-book number found (books only quote the standard HOU-1.5/SD+1.5 direction), benchmark-unreachable, consistent with the recurring alternate-line-mismatch trap. CPI/GDP brackets all >=3 days from release (earliest Aug 10), within re-research cooldown, nothing new expected, not re-derived. funnel.jsonl: 5 researched entries, 0 bets. Open-position monitor: d2dd24206542 (Iran ceasefire No) entry 0.92, live bid/ask 0.12/0.13 (quote.py), mid 0.125, adverse move -0.795 (flagged, continued slow decline vs 22:20Z's mid 0.135, still 7+ days past end date and unresolved, already tracked in journal/proposals.md line 69, no new action). 9 full cycles ran in the last 24h (awk-counted: `awk -v cutoff="$(date -u -d '24 hours ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M)" '$0 > cutoff' journal/cycles.log | grep -v "LIGHT tick" | wc -l` = 9), min_full_cycles_per_day=4, exceeded. Set next_full_cycle_after to 01:50Z (~2.5h, just past the 01:40-01:45Z first pitches for tonight's remaining games): pre-game run lines just researched close/freeze at first pitch so re-checking them sooner is wasted, and CPI is still days out -- 01:50Z is the next genuine event boundary (tomorrow's early slate + any post-game settlements).
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick, and a settling tick writes its retro immediately (see _comment). Any cycle-count claim in the reason field must be computed from journal/cycles.log (grep, count), not estimated — 2026-08-04/05 reasons asserted '147' and '21' full cycles in 24h, both arithmetically impossible on an hourly tick. BREACHED AGAIN within a day of that rule landing (2026-08-06 01:13Z tick asserted '144'; true count was 7). Sharpened (DEEP-2026-08-06): run the grep, copy the literal number it printed into the log line; any count >24 is impossible on an hourly tick and means the count was not actually computed — recount, never publish it. Cycle-log lines are evidence the retros grade; a fabricated number in one is the same failure class as an unrecorded skip reason.
